description.ko: 고정된 이전 소스의 Linux 검사와 이후 macOS 개발 검사를 구분한다.
description.en: Separate older frozen Linux execution evidence from later macOS development checkpoints.

release_status: Unreleased development; not full latest-source target certification.

linux_x86_64.environment: Linux x86-64 guest under QEMU emulation on macOS ARM64
linux_x86_64.evidence_method: Cumulative frozen-binary baseline plus four reruns, not one coherent86-test invocation. CTest cost entries record at least one passing execution for every registered test.
linux_x86_64.test_adjustments: VM-only larger process/outer timeouts accommodate instruction emulation. A prior scalar-math fixture was corrected without changing compiler implementation. The archive identifies the transfer baseline, not that later fixture correction.
linux_x86_64.boundary: This snapshot predates later source Task, expanded bytes/Float/Range and synchronization changes. It does not validate those latest features or physical x86 hardware performance.
linux_x86_64.cleanup: VM stopped successfully after all tests completed; the host agent confirmed QEMU exit and stopped state.

linux_arm64.boundary: Earlier frozen source only. VM was stopped after its gate; not latest-source Task/bytes/Float proof.
